iso-week-calculator.name: ISO Week Date Converter
iso-week-calculator.description: Convert calendar dates and ISO 8601 week dates locally. Find week numbers, week years, and Monday–Sunday ranges; copy or download the summary.

meta.title: ISO Week Date Converter
meta.description: Convert calendar dates and ISO 8601 week dates locally. Find week numbers, week years, and Monday–Sunday ranges; copy or download the summary.
meta.keywords: ISO week, week number, ISO 8601, week date, calendar week, week year

isoWeek.dateHint: Use YYYY-MM-DD, with a year from 0001 to 9999. Example: 2021-01-01.
isoWeek.weekHint: Use YYYY-Www-D: a four-digit year (0001–9999), a two-digit week (01–53), and a weekday (1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday). Example: 2020-W53-5.
isoWeek.rules: ISO weeks start on Monday. Week 1 contains January 4, so the week year can differ from the calendar year. Calculations use Gregorian dates without times or time zones.
isoWeek.rangeHint: Converted dates must be within 0001–9999. At the upper boundary, the displayed week end may use the expanded year +010000. This is an ISO week calendar, not a locale-specific or fiscal week calendar.
isoWeek.emptyResult: Enter a date or load an example, then convert.
isoWeek.invalidDate: Enter a real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with a year from 0001 to 9999.
isoWeek.invalidWeek: Enter YYYY-Www-D with a year from 0001 to 9999, week 01–53 and weekday 1–7. Use uppercase W.
isoWeek.missingWeek: This ISO week year has only 52 weeks; week 53 does not exist.
isoWeek.outOfRange: This week date falls outside the supported calendar date range 0001–9999.
